# API Documentation

## GET /users

Returns a list of all users.

## POST /users

Creates a new user.

## GET /users/:id

Returns a specific user by ID.

## DELETE /users/:id

Deletes a user by ID.

## Functions

### add(a, b): number

Adds two numbers together.

### multiply(a, b): number

Multiplies two numbers.

### oldFunction(x): string

This function no longer exists in code.

## Types

### interface User

User data model.

### type ApiResponse

Generic API response wrapper.
